jobs.description:
Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. Through this work, they make a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of significant growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer. 

In this role, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative environment within a leading global pharmaceutical company.

As a Warehouse & Operations Associate, your responsibilities will primarily focus on operational warehouse activities with an accurate administrative follow-up. 
	
• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.	
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.	
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.	
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.	
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.	
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities.

	
• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.	
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.	
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.	
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.	
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.	
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

At Inetum Belgium, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. We strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

Job Description

Forget about conventional communication styles, the main language we speak is Java. So, If you are looking to upgrade your skills and working on exciting and challenging projects; just scroll down your mouse and learn how you can become the next Java developer Expert Inetum-Belgium is searching for.

As Java developer it will be expected of you:

 
• To share and upgrade your skills through multiple projects ranging from new applications & functionalities developments to complex cross-projects developments. Including elaboration and contribution to maintenance standards.
 
• To share you expertise and exchange about projects status and issues during the Scrum meetings.
 
• To help identify and bring your contribution to key improvements elements of development projects.
 
• To take the lead on the quality of the delivery by playing a proactive role in the testing phases at all the necessary steps of the development.
 
• To ensure the delivery of well designed, testable and efficient code
 
• To coach and help junior profiles on some matters (if you feel comfortable)

Discover your future with inetum belgium

 
• Make a Difference with a Meaningful Career: step into a role where your work truly matters. At Inetum Belgium, you'll have the chance to impact lives and drive meaningful change every day.
 
• Grow and Evolve Professionally: embrace a culture of continuous learning and development. We offer a range of training opportunities designed to help you expand your skills and advance your career.
 
• Unlock Relevant Career Opportunities: pursue the career path you've always dreamed of with tailored opportunities and the IT expertise you need to succeed.
 
• Achieve Work-Life Balance: we value your well-being. Enjoy flexible working hours, the convenience of satellite offices, the comfort of home working, and an informal, no-nonsense environment.
 
• Enjoy Generous Annual Leave: life is more than just work. Take advantage of 32 days of annual leave to relax and recharge.
 
• Travel in Comfort: forget the hassle of commuting. We provide a company car and a national fuel/charging card to keep you on the move. Prefer a different option? You can choose a mobility allowance instead

jobs.occupation: Inside Sales Representative (English + East EU language)
jobs.description:
As an Inside Sales Representative, you are responsible for providing excellent service and commercial support to customers in a specific region: Middle East, Africa and Eastern Europe. You work hand in hand with the External Sales Representative and help strengthen customer relationships, drive sales growth, and promote the use of our digital tools. 

Key responsibilities:
 
 

• Open new customer accounts (approx. 30%) and grow business with existing customers (approx. 70%) 

• Prepare accurate offers and price calculations 

• Enter and follow up on orders 

• Actively manage your accounts via phone and email, with a focus on cross-selling and digital migration 

• Maintain and update customer data in the internal system 

• Understand customer needs, market context, product applications, and competitors 

• Be the main point of contact for customer inquiries, complaints, and support 

• Identify and close commercial opportunities 

• Report on sales projects and progress in close collaboration with External Sales 

• Contribute to the team with flexibility and a hands-on attitude 
 

• You have a technical and/or commercial background 

• You have at least 4 years of B2B sales experience, preferably with technical products 

• You are fluent in English (spoken and written) – mandatory 

• Polish, Czech or another Eastern European language is a strong asset 

• French and/or Arabic is an asset 

• Strong skills in Excel and general IT tools 

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Secure a stable future as a Reach Truck Driver at Caterpillar in Grimbergen, offering €16.72/hour, a 10% shift premium, and €7 daily meal vouchers.

Ready to elevate your logistics career with a global industry leader? Join Caterpillar to manage heavy machinery parts while building a long-term professional journey. We offer an environment that prioritizes your safety, growth, and continuous development.

Apply today, and our AI agent will contact you via WhatsApp for a quick screening, followed by a personalized review from our dedicated consultant. Take the next step as a Reach Truck Driver and let us support your success!

VG 458/BUOSAP

• Demonstrate proven experience operating a reach truck to handle materials safely. 
• Possess the physical fitness to comfortably handle loads up to 25 kg while prioritizing ergonomics. 
• Communicate effectively in Dutch or English to fully understand safety procedures. 
• Embrace a collaborative mindset with a commitment to working in a dynamic two-shift system from 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM.

• Drive the reach truck to accurately move, stack, and store heavy machinery components. 
• Manage incoming and outgoing product flows with a sharp eye for detail to ensure seamless operations. 
• Execute various warehouse tasks collaboratively to help your team achieve daily goals. 
• Maintain a safe and supportive work environment that adheres to high industrial quality standards.

Are you an experienced Head Technician with strong troubleshooting skills and knowledge of mechanical, hydraulic and electrical systems? Do you work confidently in English? Apply today.

As a Head Technician, Senior Mechanic or Technical Coordinator, you combine hands-on technical expertise with the daily coordination of a small team. Your main focus is diagnosing and resolving technical issues on heavy equipment.
 
• Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hydraulic and electrical faults. 
• Perform assembly, disassembly and modification work on machines. 
• Carry out machine inspections and functional checks. 
• Support machine testing, commissioning and validation activities. 
• Prepare technical reports and troubleshooting guidelines. 
• Coordinate daily work planning and priorities for two mechanics. 
• Perform quality inspections and support continuous improvement initiatives.
For this position, you bring:
 
• Experience in construction equipment, heavy equipment, agricultural machinery, automotive or industrial maintenance. 
• Strong mechanical knowledge. 
• Knowledge of hydraulic and electrical systems. 
• Proven experience in troubleshooting and technical fault finding. 
• Experience coordinating or guiding technicians in daily work planning. 
• Good command of English, as this is the working language. 
• Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook. 
• Sufficient computer skills to work with digital reporting tools and systems.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Accountant to join the Finance team in Leuven.

In this role, you will be a key pillar of our 6-member financial department, taking ownership of accounting tasks from A to Z.

To succeed, you must be experienced in Belgian and familiar with international accounting principles, highly analytical, and possess an high attention to detail. Your goal will be to drive the overall efficiency of our financial operations, ensure the accuracy and compliance of the day-to-day accounting and manage the month end closing process.

• Support the AP accountant with incoming invoices in accordance with Belgian accounting and VAT principles

• Manage the AP invoice approval cycle efficiently.

• Take ownership of the AP accounting for our subsidiaries (Germany, The Netherlands, UK, Finland, and Singapore). 

• Support bookings and meticulously reconcile bank statements.

• Register journal entries payroll bookings for Belgium and international entities.

• Manage fixed assets and book depreciations across all subsidiaries.

• Register prepaid expenses, accruals, and provisions.

• Prepare and file Belgian VAT returns, as well as VAT filings for foreign subsidiaries.

• Lead the monthly closing process for all corporate entities.

• Assist with group-level financial reconciliations, consolidation and reporting.
 

• Education: minimum Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Finance, Accountancy) or equivalent experience.

• Experience: Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience with Belgian accounting rules and VAT.

• Languages: Excellent command of English (spoken and written) alongside a good working knowledge of Dutch.

• Skills: Strong analytical acumen, great comfort with numbers, and an uncompromising attention to detail.

• Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of Belgian accounting and financial reporting practices. Advanced knowledge of MS Office is required.

• Pluses: Previous experience with NetSuite and/or Salesforce is considered a strong asset.

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Are you a hands-on and service-minded professional who enjoys creating a welcoming and well-organised workplace? In this varied role, you will ensure the smooth daily operation of a modern international office while acting as a key contact for employees, visitors and external service providers.

 

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international organisation based in Brussels, bringing together professionals and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a dynamic and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in supporting collaboration, policy development and industry best practices on an international scale.

With employees and members from numerous countries, the organisation offers a collaborative workplace where professionalism, continuous improvement and teamwork are highly valued.

 

Description

• Welcome visitors and act as the main point of contact for employees, guests and external partners.
• Ensure the office remains operational, organised and ready for daily business activities.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, prepare meeting spaces and support internal events and workshops.
• Manage office supplies, catering services, incoming and outgoing mail, and document archiving.
• Liaise with external suppliers and service providers to ensure smooth facility operations.
• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of building systems and office equipment.
• Support workspace optimisation projects, including storage and inventory management.
• Contribute to creating a professional, safe and pleasant working environment for all employees and visitors.
 

• Secondary education diploma or equivalent experience.
• Initial experience (1 to 3 years) in office coordination, workplace services, hospitality, reception or administrative support.
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English, combined with a good knowledge of either French or Dutch. Knowledge of both is a strong asset.
• Customer-oriented and proactive mindset with a strong sense of service.
• Organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, discreet and able to work autonomously while remaining a true team player.
• Available to work on-site on a full-time basis.

Are you an organised and service-oriented professional who enjoys being at the heart of office life? In this part-time role, you will support the daily operations of a busy international office, ensuring employees and visitors enjoy a seamless and welcoming workplace experience.

 

Client Details

Our client is an internationally active organisation with offices across multiple countries. Their Brussels team operates in a professional, collaborative and multicultural environment where efficiency, excellent service and teamwork are key to success.

As the organisation continues to grow, they are looking for a reliable Office Operations Assistant to help maintain smooth day-to-day office activities and provide essential administrative support.

 

Description

• Act as the first point of contact for visitors, answering calls and welcoming guests professionally.
• Provide administrative support including data entry, document preparation, proofreading and reporting.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, catering arrangements and logistics for internal meetings and events.
• Manage office supplies, kitchen stock, consumables and general workplace organisation.
• Handle incoming and outgoing mail, deliveries and courier services.
• Support facilities-related requests and liaise with external suppliers when needed.
• Assist with access badge administration, workspace set-up and daily office inspections.
• Prepare the office for opening and help maintain a clean, organised and professional working environment.
 

• You have at least 1 year of experience in administration, office coordination, reception or workplace support.
• You are comfortable using Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word and Excel.
• You communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of French and/or Dutch is considered an asset.
• You are highly organised, proactive and able to multitask effectively.
• You have a strong service mindset and enjoy supporting both colleagues and visitors.
• You are hands-on and willing to assist with practical office and facilities-related tasks.
• You are reliable, discreet and able to work independently.
• You are available to work on-site in Brussels on a part-time basis, Monday to Friday from 9AM to 1PM.

We are currently looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist, fluent in French and English, to join a team based in Brussels.

In this temporary assignment, you will play a key role in supporting the full recruitment cycle within the professional services sector. Your responsibilities will include sourcing talent, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and ensuring an efficient and positive hiring process.

Client Details

A professional services organisation based in Brussels.

Description

As a recruiter your responsibilities are:

 

• Source and attract candidates using various recruitment channels.
• Screen and shortlist applicants based on job requirements.
• Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers.
• Maintain and update recruitment databases and records.
• Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Provide support in contract preparation and onboarding processes.
• Collaborate with the HR team to meet recruitment goals.
• Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and procedures

• Bilingual in French and English (mandatory)
• Previous experience in recruitment is required
• Enjoys daily interaction with people while also appreciating administrative tasks
• Available immediately
• Temporary contract, with a potential opportunity for a permanent position

Do you enjoy staying active and feel at home in a logistics environment? As a Logistics employee, you ensure that our finished products are shipped smoothly and correctly to our customers.

What will you be doing at Agristo?
 
• You ensure the correct dispatch of finished products to the loading dock.

• You handle goods safely and efficiently using a forklift truck and electric pallet truck.

jobs.occupation: Head of Sales - Regulated B2B Services
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international service provider operating across multiple countries in Europe and beyond. With several hundred employees in Belgium and a strong position in its market, the company is currently entering a new phase of growth driven by innovation, strategic partnerships and evolving customer needs.

To support this development, our client is looking for a Head of Sales Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the Managing Director and sitting on the local leadership team, you will lead the commercial function, shape the sales strategy, develop key customer relationships and manage a team of experienced sales professionals.Commercial Strategy & Growth

• Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Belgian market.
• Translate business objectives into clear action plans and measurable KPIs.
• Identify growth opportunities and drive business development initiatives.
• Monitor commercial performance, sales activity and pipeline development.
• Contribute to the overall business strategy as a member of the management team.

Team Leadership

• Lead, coach and develop a team of 3 sales professionals.
• Foster a high-performance culture focused on customer value and commercial results.
• Support the team in managing complex sales cycles and strategic accounts.
• Ensure effective collaboration across departments.

Key Account Management

• Build and maintain long-term relationships with major national customers.
• Manage executive-level conversations with key decision-makers.
• Lead commercial negotiations and contract discussions.
• Act as a trusted partner for strategic clients and stakeholders.

Marketing Coordination

• Coordinate local marketing initiatives in collaboration with international colleagues.
• Manage relationships with external marketing partners and agencies.
• Support brand visibility, customer engagement and commercial campaigns.
• Contribute to market positioning and business growth initiatives.

What matters most is your ability to lead teams, build commercial strategies and drive business results in a B2B environment.

You bring:

• A proven track record in a B2B commercial leadership role.
• Experience managing and developing sales teams.
• Strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking skills.
• Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities.
• Experience working with large accounts and complex customer environments.
• The ability to build structure, set priorities and drive execution.
• A hands-on mindset combined with strong leadership qualities.
• Curiosity and the willingness to learn and understand a new industry.
• Fluency in Dutch, French, English

What if the algorithms you build don’t just run in simulation, but actually 
see, understand, and navigate the real world?
 

At M-ECS, you’ll turn perception algorithms into robust, real-time systems that help make off-highway vehicles and other robotic platforms autonomous. You’ll work at the intersection of computer vision, robotics and embedded systems, helping machines understand their surroundings and operate autonomously in demanding industrial and heavy-field environments.
You’ll be part of the team shaping the next generation of autonomous machines, turning bold ideas into technology that works in the field.
 

You’ll see your work move from 
algorithm → machine → real-world impact.
 

YOUR ROLE, YOUR IMPACT.
 

As a hands-on Computer Vision & Perception Engineer, you’ll help build the perception capabilities that enable autonomous machines to operate safely and reliably in demanding real-world environments, from off-highway vehicles to other robotic platforms.
 

Key responsibilities:
 
 

• Developing perception capabilities for object detection, classification, multi-object tracking, depth estimation, and 3D reconstructions. 

• Processing and fusing sensor data from cameras, LiDAR, radar and GNSS/IMU systems to create reliable, real-time machine awareness. 

• Contributing to SLAM and localization systems that help machines understand where they are and where they’re going. 

• Optimizing algorithms for real-time execution on embedded and GPU platforms. 

• Bringing algorithms to life by integrating perception into machine control and navigation systems. 

• Testing and validating your work on real machines together with System Engineers. 

• Debugging and optimizing perception systems during field testing. 

ARE YOU THE ONE?
 

We’re looking for an 
all-round engineer who enjoys solving complex problems that don’t always come with a manual. You’re hands-on, curious and eager to turn ideas into working systems. You’re not afraid to figure things out along the way and shift gears when needed. You thrive in a fast-paced, ambitious tech scale-up, enjoy working as part of a team and take ownership of delivering high-quality results. 
 
 

• A 
 master’s degree in Automation, Robotics, AI, Computer Vision, or a related field. 

• 2–5 years of relevant experience, ideally in industrial automation, robotics or mobile machinery or equivalent hands-on experience. 

• Strong programming skills in 
Python and/or 
C++. 

• Hands-on experience with 
computer vision and deep learning for 
perception, including OpenCV, YOLO, or similar frameworks. 

• Solid understanding of 
sensor fusion, 
3D geometry, and 
coordinate transformations. 

• Knowledge of 
robotics and 
autonomous systems. 

• The ability to debug real-world systems, not just offline datasets. 

• Experience with ROS/ROS2, LiDAR, SLAM, edge platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, embedded optimization, or dataset pipelines is a plus. 

• Strong communication skills in 
English and 
Dutch.

Are you an experienced Technical Superintendent or maritime engineer with a passion for inland shipping, vessel management, and technical operations? Do you speak German fluently and enjoy working closely with crews and shipyards?
 

This is your opportunity to take a key role in managing a modern inland fleet in the Antwerp region.
 

Your Role as Technical Superintendent
 

As a Technical Superintendent Inland Shipping, you are responsible for the technical performance, maintenance, and reliability of the fleet. You act as the crucial link between crew, suppliers, and management.
 

Key responsibilities:
 
 
 
• Monitor the technical condition and operational performance of vessels 
 
• Plan and coordinate maintenance, repairs, and inspections 
 
• Visit vessels regularly (2–3 times per week) 
 
• Provide technical support to crews and build strong working relationships 
 
• Handle technical incidents and breakdowns (on-call rotation) 
 
• Manage and execute technical projects, refits, and upgrades 
 
• Develop and follow up on preventive maintenance plans (PMS) 
 
• Maintain contact with shipyards, suppliers, and classification societies 
 
• Manage the technical budget and advise on long-term investments 

Your Profile:
 
 
 
• Bachelor’s degree in Maritime Technology, Electromechanics, or Engineering 
 
• Proven experience as a Technical Superintendent / Vessel Manager (preferably inland shipping) 
 
• Fluent in German and English (mandatory requirement) 
 
• Knowledge of ship engines, propulsion systems, and electrical installations 
 
• Experience with PMS systems and technical documentation 
 
• Familiar with classification rules and maritime regulations 
 
• Strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on mentality 
 
• Excellent communicator, able to connect with technical teams and crew 
 
• Flexible and willing to travel frequently

jobs.occupation: Multilingual Customer Advisor – DE/EN/(NL or FR) in Liège
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about delivering outstanding customer service and fluent in multiple languages? As a Customer Advisor in our Liège-based team, you’ll be the first point of contact for customers, ensuring their needs are met with professionalism and efficiency. You’ll interact with international clients through various channels – calls, emails, and chat – providing accurate, friendly, and timely support.

You will support Satellic customers through different communication channels and provide professional, efficient assistance regarding their requests and issues: handling calls, emails, and chats related to the road toll for freight vehicles in Belgium and, in the future, other projects such as Monizze, Arrive, Fain and verification of on-board documents via the CRM system.

Ready to take the next step in your career? If you have strong language skills, a commitment to delivering excellent service, and thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment, we want to hear from you. Apply today and become a valued member of our international customer service team in Liège!

• Excellent command of English, both spoken and written

• Successful completion of an English language assessment

• Strong communication and customer service skills

• Good computer literacy and ability to learn new systems

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

• Fluency in one or more of the following language combinations: Dutch + English, German + English, German + English + French, or German + English + Dutch

• Trilingual candidates are highly valued

• Additional language skills may qualify for a language bonus

• Upper secondary education completed

• 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in customer service or a related field

• Full-time availability
